item.title: Hot Observable, Cold Observable
item.description:
습관처럼 사용하는 Observable에 대해서 제대로 알고 쓰고자 다시 정리를 해보았다!

개념

먼저 공식문서에 따르면 (https://reactivex.io/documentation/observable.html)

“Hot” and “Cold” Observables When does an Observable begin emitting its sequence of items? It depends on the Observable. A “hot” Observable may begin emitting items as soon as it is created, and so any observer who later subscribes to that Observable may start observing the sequence somewhere in the middle. A “cold” Observable, on the other hand, waits until an observer subscribes to it before it begins to emit items, and so such an observer is guaranteed to see the whole sequence from the beginning. In some implementations of ReactiveX, there is also something called a “Connectable” Observable. Such an Observable does not begin emitting items until its Connect method is called, whether or not any observers have subscribed to it.
